title: Store records, delivery journal and MLS state in one SQLite transaction
description:
Investigated in mimid-1vul.4 (2026-11-20). The store's records are in chat.sqlite, separate from mls.sqlite, so the delivery journal's crash window (crates/mimid-agent-core/src/journal.rs Limitations: OpenMLS writes consumed secrets before the journal entry is written) stays open, and records and acknowledgement are two commits.

What openmls_sqlite_storage (MarkAtwood/openmls f1680d98) allows: SqliteStorageProvider<C, ConnectionRef: Borrow<rusqlite::Connection>> runs each statement directly on the borrowed connection, with no BEGIN/COMMIT of its own (storage_provider.rs, 'the application should call this within a transaction'). So OpenMLS writes join any transaction the caller has open on that connection, and the store's tables could live in mls.sqlite.

What one transaction needs:
1. One rusqlite::Connection owned by mimid-agent-core (mimi_mls::Store today opens its own, crates/mimi-mls/src/store.rs). It must be reachable by OpenMLS (Borrow<Connection>; Rc/Arc are not Send+Sync for Connection, so the Agent keeps it by value and lends &Connection, or mimi-mls takes a wrapper) and by the store crate, without unsafe.
2. The journal moves from state.json into a table of that database (journal.rs).
3. Agent::receive wraps each server message's processing (OpenMLS + journal write) in one transaction; Store::sync's record writes and the acknowledgement share another, or the store writes its records inside the agent's transaction API.
4. mimid-agent-store gets the connection from the agent instead of opening chat.sqlite; refinery migration tables of OpenMLS and the store's user_version must not collide (OpenMLS uses its own migrations table; the store would need a table-based version instead of PRAGMA user_version, which is per database).
Not started: it changes mimi-mls and mimid-agent-core's public APIs.
close_reason: Built on branch one-txn (worktree /data/PROJECT/mimid-worktrees/one-txn), not pushed: a5c371b (mimi-mls: Store owns the connection, Store::connection, Identity::store), 4fc5d9f (agent-core: agent.sqlite with OpenMLS tables, agent_state, journal, schema_version; per-Message transaction in receive; acknowledge_in; fail-points feature), bafe12d (agent-store: records in the agent's database on a second connection, records + acknowledgement in one transaction, schema 3; AgentChat::persisted; tests/crash.rs), 291e6d9 (design note §3 step 9, AGENTS.md). Design: two connections to one file, two transactions per delivery; the journal stays as the hand-off. Filed mimid-0ssc (pre-existing tools/interop/chat dependency conflict).
